evals.prompt: Discovery review CHK01 — are we Ready for Development?
evals.expected_output: Inventory of discovery artefacts, findings by tier, Ready or Not ready verdict. No Solution Design or task files modified.
assertions: Resolves the work item and work dir before judging
Inventories design.md, tasks/AC, and ARCHITECTURE.md when relevant
Gives an explicit Ready for Development or Not ready verdict
Groups findings as blocking / warning / suggestion
Every finding cites a path and a heading or line
Names the owning skill for each gap
Does not amend design.md, TASKS.local.md, or ARCHITECTURE.md

evals.prompt: Can we start implementing checkout-foundation? The TDD §5 still has [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] on which payment provider, and that choice changes the files shipped.
evals.expected_output: Not ready. The open clarification is blocking.
assertions: Verdict is Not ready
Rates the payment-provider clarification blocking
Explains that implement would have to guess the slice or files
Does not start implement

evals.prompt: Review the TDD and tasks. CHK01-03 has Given/When but no Then.
evals.expected_output: Untestable AC raised as blocking; owner is /product-management:tasks.
assertions: Rates missing Then as blocking
Owner is /product-management:tasks
Does not treat 'the tasks file exists' as sufficient

evals.prompt: Ready for development? design.md restates the module layout from ARCHITECTURE.md §5 with the same facts, and cites nothing.
evals.expected_output: Boundary finding; warning unless the restatement has already diverged.
assertions: Flags restated architecture that should be a citation
Does not fail the gate solely for a faithful restatement with no factual clash
Would rate a factual clash with ARCHITECTURE.md as blocking

evals.prompt: Are we ready to build? design.md, TASKS.local.md, and ARCHITECTURE.md are complete; AC are testable; no open questions that change the slice.
evals.expected_output: Ready for Development; next is implement on the first task.
assertions: Verdict is Ready for Development
Does not invent blocking findings from prose style
Names implement as next, not validate

evals.prompt: Review the docs/ folder — is our documentation consistent?
evals.expected_output: Refuse this skill's job; route to docs-review.
assertions: Does not run a handbook or docs/ tree quality review
Routes to docs-review
Does not produce a Ready for Development verdict for a docs tree
